name: EPIC 248790186
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 5.8 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248790186 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.834226 (16th-84th percentiles 5.622836-6.063052), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,589 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.94 solar masses and 5.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,933 K at its surface.
